title: Analysis of HDO Autoxidation Products by UHPLC-DAD
author: Stefan J. Haugen

steps.title: Prepare Mobile Phase A
steps.instruction: Make a 20 mM phosphoric‑acid solution by adding 1.34 mL of 85 % phosphoric acid to 1 L ultrapure water (UPW); prepare enough volume for all samples and standards.

steps.title: Prepare Mobile Phase B
steps.instruction: Use methanol as Mobile Phase B and prepare sufficient volume for the analysis.

steps.title: Filter Samples Prior to Injection
steps.instruction: Pass each sample through a 0.2 µm (or smaller) filter before UHPLC injection; if a sample’s concentration exceeds the instrument’s calibration range, dilute it with UPW to bring it within range and avoid carry‑over.

steps.title: Prepare 1 M Phosphate Buffers
steps.instruction: Create the required phosphate buffers for TPA preparation.

substeps.instruction: Weigh 87 g potassium phosphate dibasic (K₂HPO₄) into 500 mL 18.2 MΩ·cm ultrapure water to make a 1 M K₂HPO₄ buffer.
Weigh 68 g potassium phosphate monobasic (KH₂PO₄) into 500 mL ultrapure water to make a 1 M KH₂PO₄ buffer.

Combine 94 mL of the 1 M K₂HPO₄ buffer with 6 mL of the 1 M KH₂PO₄ buffer to obtain a 1 M phosphate buffer; verify the pH is 8.0 ± 0.1 (acceptable range 7.9–8.1) and adjust with 10 N NaOH or concentrated phosphoric acid if necessary.

steps.title: Prepare TPA Stock and Working Standards
steps.instruction: Generate the TPA calibration solutions using the phosphate buffer prepared above.

substeps.instruction: Weigh 9.8 mg (9 800 µg) dry terephthalic acid (TPA) and dissolve in 9.8 mL of the 1 M phosphate buffer to make a 1000 µg/mL TPA stock solution.
Pipette 2.5 mL of the 1000 µg/mL stock into 7.5 mL ultrapure water to obtain a 250 µg/mL TPA working standard.
Use the 250 µg/mL working standard and ultrapure water to prepare the required calibration standards as described in the protocol.

steps.title: Prepare Mixed Standard Working Solutions
steps.instruction: Create the two mixed standard mixes (Aro and HDO) that will be used for calibration curves.

substeps.instruction: For each analyte listed in the Materials section, weigh enough solid to give a 2.0 g/L (2000 ppm) concentration in its specified diluent; keep all individual stocks at 2.0 g/L.
Combine the individual 2.0 g/L stocks according to the provided combination scheme to generate the Aro mSWS and the HDO mSWS.

steps.title: Dilute mSWS to Calibration Levels
steps.instruction: Generate the full set of calibration levels from the mixed standard working solutions.

substeps.instruction: Starting with the highest level (level 8) and proceeding to the lowest (level 1), dilute the Aro and HDO mSWS as outlined in the dilution scheme.

Prepare levels 8, 7, and 5 directly from the undiluted mSWS; prepare levels 6, 4, 3, and 2 by diluting level 7, level 5, and level 1 respectively, using ultrapure water as diluent and following the exact volume ratios indicated in the protocol.

steps.title: Set UHPLC Detection Parameters
steps.instruction: Configure the UHPLC system with Mobile Phases A and B, apply the defined gradient and flow settings, and set the diode‑array detector to monitor 240 nm for all analytes.

steps.title: Perform Calibration and Verification
steps.instruction: Run calibration standards for each analyte, requiring a linear correlation coefficient r² ≥ 0.995 (use 1/x weighting); after every ≤20 sample injections, re‑inject a calibration verification standard (CVS) and accept recoveries within ±10 % of the expected value; if CVS criteria are not met, repeat the calibration before proceeding with further analysis.
